title: Tasman SH60 intersection improvement underway
summary: The Government is progressing important safety improvements to a key Tasman State Highway intersection, following community concern after multiple crashes.

title: Government support for weather-hit Southland and Clutha farmers
summary: Agriculture Minister Todd McClay and Rural Communities Minister Mark Patterson have today classified the extreme wet and cold conditions across Southland and the Clutha District as a medium-scale adverse event.

title: New explorer seeks second petroleum permit
summary: Enzed Energy, the first explorer to be awarded a new petroleum exploration permit since the repeal of the offshore exploration ban, has lodged a second application targeting the promising Toutouwai prospect in the offshore Taranaki Basin.

title: New ACOPs clarify health and safety responsibilities on farms
summary: Workplace Relations and Safety Minister Brooke van Velden today launched two new Approved Codes of Practice [ACOP] that outline practical steps businesses and workers can take to meet their health and safety responsibilities on farms.

title: Patient community helps improve access to paediatric cancer medicines for young Kiwis
summary: Associate Health Minister David Seymour and Health Minister Simeon Brown have today welcomed Pharmac’s decision to expand access to funded cancer treatments for adolescents and young adults with paediatric-origin cancers.
